label.zh: 选“以后再说”后，这支车队下次穿越国境时的最后一次报价（间隔至少360天）
label.en: After choosing "get back to us later": the last offer when the fleet next crosses the border (at least 360 days apart)

bridges.evidence: events/caravaneer_events.txt: cara.2250 fleet_event on_crossing_border needs flag cara_fleet2_getback (set by the option), sets a 360-day timer and fires country_event cara.2251

notes.zh: 评注：车队穿越国境进入本国（on_crossing_border → cara.2010，同一帝国540天内只触发一次）时，若与其有通讯、本国不嗜杀且没有打开的外交窗口，便弹出交易菜单；初次接触时则是 cara.2020。
notes.en: Commentary: when the fleet crosses into the empire (on_crossing_border -> cara.2010, once per 540 days per empire) and the empire is in communication, not homicidal and has no open diplomacy window, the trade menu opens; at first contact cara.2020 shows instead.

notes.zh: 评注：本国舰队歼灭这支车队时（on_fleet_destroyed_perp）弹出，给舰队指挥官添加特质，并通知其他帝国（cara.2003）。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the empire's fleet destroys this caravan (on_fleet_destroyed_perp); it gives the fleet's leader a trait and notifies other empires (cara.2003).

scope.zh: 车队的行程、交易菜单、初次接触、最后一次报价和被歼灭后的通知均已核对。
scope.en: The fleet's route, trade menu, first-contact message, last offer and the destruction notices were checked.

uncertain: The contents of a deal are generated by cara_generate_deal2 and shown by scripted localisation; the full product list was not enumerated.
